_comment: Commits the heuristic in unlanded.py flags that a human or orchestrator has already SETTLED, with the settling evidence. The report prints these in their own short section instead of in the unlanded list, so a resuming orchestrator does not re-chase the same commit every five hours. Add an entry ONLY after actually running the command the report prescribes: `git diff <integration> <branch> -- $(git show --name-only --format= <commit>)`. Keyed by abbreviated sha; the value is the reason, and the reason is what makes the entry trustworthy. Entries are removed when the report says the heuristic no longer flags them — dd28fd3d was dropped by the followups-4 agent within the hour and its entry went with it.
c8239748: SETTLED 2026-09-13 (round 23). task/p2-005-device-maturity. The prescribed diff across the one file it touches (tests/test-device-firewall-netns.sh) against roadmap/v2.2 is EMPTY. The heuristic flags it because the file was landed and then rewritten, which is the false positive its own docstring warns about. Content-landed; nothing to do.
4a0ed98: SETTLED 2026-09-20 (round 33). apex-shell task/p0-022-agents-help. The prescribed diff -- `git diff origin/roadmap/v2.2 origin/task/p0-022-agents-help -- $(git show --name-only --format= 4a0ed98)` across all ten files it touches (.github/workflows/ci.yml, .slopcheck-allow, src/qmldir and the seven src/services/agents/AgentHelp* and AgentCenter.qml files) is EMPTY. Content-landed; the heuristic flags it at 7/10 because the files were landed and then rewritten, which is the false positive its own docstring warns about. NOTE for anyone tempted to merge the branch anyway: `git merge-tree` reports CONFLICTS against the integration tip, which is consistent with landed-then-rewritten and is NOT evidence of missing work -- merging it would reintroduce the older shape of files that have since moved on. Nothing to do.
